what_this_is: Every sentence Recon builds from data: the short reason on a held row, the full reason, and the drafted note. Code fills the [names]; the AI writes none of these.

duplicate_new_number.full: Same order line and amount as [original_number], with no new delivery since.

no_order.full: No open order with any supplier fits these parts.

freight_not_ordered.full: Freight of [freight] is not on the order.

tax_not_expected.full: Tax of [tax] added; the order expected none.

unit_unknown.full: Billed [boxes] [unit]; the order is in pieces ([order_qty]), and the box size isn't on file.

credit_no_return.full: A credit note with no return logged against it.

statement.full: A statement listing earlier bills, not a new bill.

pro_forma.full: A pro forma asking for a deposit. Nothing has arrived.

packing_slip.full: A packing slip, not a bill. Used to check [for_doc].

bank_details_change.full: Asks to send payments to new bank details.

no_po_supplier.row: billed without an order, as usual
no_po_supplier.full: This supplier bills every month without an order.

different_payee.full: Billed by [supplier] for order [po], which was placed with [maker].

arithmetic.full: The lines, freight and tax add up to [sum], the bill says [total].

no_lines.full: No billed line could be read.

names_no_invoice.full: The payment names no invoice. The amount matches [suggested].

names_paid_invoice.full: Names [named], already paid. The amount matches [suggested].

unknown_supplier.full: Not from a supplier on file.

unknown_customer.full: Not from a customer on file.

unknown_order.full: Names order [po], which isn't in the books.

billed_beyond_received.full: With this bill, [billed] are billed on [po] and [received] have arrived.

credit_mismatch.full: Credit of [credit] for return [return], which was for [return_amount].

credit_used.full: Return [return] already has a credit this month.

unknown_invoice.full: Names [named], which isn't one of our invoices.

duplicate_entered.full: Sent again: [original] was entered [received] and is already in the books.

negative_amounts.full: A zero or negative quantity, price or total on a bill.

billed_beyond_ordered.full: With this bill, [billed] are billed on [po]; the order is for [ordered].

corrected_bill.full: Same number as [original] ([received]) with a different total. Is it a corrected bill?

names_no_invoice_unmatched.full: The payment names no invoice, and no open invoice has this amount.

invoice_differs.row: invoice differs from the sales order
invoice_differs.full: The [what] on the invoice is [invoiced]; the sales order says [ordered].

could_not_decide.full: Recon couldn't decide this one. Held for a person.

cleared_notes.price_within_rule: Price [pct] over the order, inside the rule.
cleared_notes.freight_small: Freight of [freight] not on the order, under the limit.
